paper_record.title: Geometric Pumping of Optical Work in Coherent Wave Scattering
paper_record.abstract: Optical work exchanged between light and time-varying matter underlies a wide range of emerging photonic technologies, yet a general geometric theory describing its generation and control has been lacking. Here we establish such a theory for coherent electromagnetic scattering. We show that the net optical work accumulated during an adiabatic modulation cycle is a geometric quantity determined by the Berry curvature of the outgoing field in parameter space. Nonzero optical work can thus be generated by cyclically modulating two or more independent system parameters. In contrast to conventional adiabatic pumping between incoherent reservoirs, optical work pumping vanishes under maximally mixed illumination. Greater illumination coherence increases the maximum work attainable through wavefront shaping. For fully coherent illumination, we derive the optimal incident wavefront and modulation trajectory that maximize the optical work per cycle. Our framework unifies time-varying photonics, optomechanics, and geometric transport within a common scattering formalism.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 本文建立了一个针对相干光散射中光学做功的绝热几何理论，证明了循环调制多个系统参数可以产生由贝里曲率决定的净光学做功。
one_sentence_summary.en: This paper establishes a general geometric theory of optical work in coherent wave scattering, proving that cyclically modulating multiple parameters generates net optical work determined by the Berry curvature.

problem.zh: 以往的绝热泵浦研究主要关注非相干库之间的守恒量输运，缺乏一个统一的几何理论来描述含时光子学和光力学中光学做功的生成与控制。
problem.en: Previous studies on adiabatic pumping focused on transport between incoherent reservoirs, lacking a unified geometric theory to describe the generation and control of optical work in time-varying photonics and optomechanics.

approach.zh: 利用含时幺正散射矩阵形式体系，推导了无穷小参数变化下的光学做功公式，并通过广义斯托克斯定理将闭合回路积分转化为依赖贝里曲率的面积分。
approach.en: Using a time-varying unitary scattering matrix formalism, the authors derive the optical work formula for infinitesimal parameter variations and transform closed-loop integrals into surface integrals dependent on the Berry curvature via generalized Stokes' theorem.

main_takeaway.zh: 绝热调制下积累的净光学做功是一个几何量，至少需要独立调制两个参数才能产生非零做功，且做功随入射光相干性的增加而增大，最大混杂态下做功为零。
main_takeaway.en: The net optical work accumulated under adiabatic modulation is a geometric quantity requiring at least two independently modulated parameters, increasing with illumination coherence and vanishing under maximally mixed states.

why_it_matters.zh: 该理论统一了含时光子学、光力学与几何输运，并为利用波前整形和参数空间轨迹优化在复杂光学系统中最大化能量交换提供了新途径。
why_it_matters.en: This framework unifies time-varying photonics, optomechanics, and geometric transport, providing a new avenue for maximizing energy exchange in complex optical systems via wavefront shaping and parameter-space trajectory optimization.

reason.zh: 该工作将绝热泵浦理论从非相干输运成功推广至相干波散射中的光学做功，建立了优美的几何表述并给出了波前与轨迹优化的实用框架。
reason.en: The work successfully extends adiabatic pumping theory from incoherent transport to optical work in coherent wave scattering, establishing an elegant geometric description and a practical framework for optimization.

reason.zh: 该研究具有广泛的物理基础、普适的理论推导以及在光子学和光力学中的明确应用，符合 PRL 的高影响力与通用性标准。
reason.en: The study features broad physical foundations, universal theoretical derivations, and clear applications in photonics and optomechanics, matching PRL's standards for high impact and generality.
